NSCameraUsageDescription: Seixo uses the camera to scan a contact's QR code and to take photos you choose to send. Photos are encrypted on your phone before they leave it.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Seixo only sees the photo you choose to send, never your library. The image is encrypted on your phone before it leaves, without its location or other photo data.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Seixo uses the microphone only to record voice messages. Recordings are encrypted on your phone before they leave, and nothing is sent unless you send it.
NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Seixo uses Face ID only to unlock the app on this device. Nothing leaves your phone.
